basis: body landmarks at source resolution, not cell or effect alpha bounds
calibration_method: direct side-by-side main-body review on dark/light at common units; full foreleg/torso and facial-fur outline cross-check, exclude wings/pets/tail extent from size fitting
same_view_policy: fixed1.06 transform across all16 drawings and7 states, retain actual pose displacement; no per-frame silhouette normalization
native_ground: 628/640 from canvas top; same native baseline used by classic/Hana/Jeanne
native_window_minimum_width: 1.30 * petWidth +12 * petScale, only angel; prevents fitting main body down to wings and companion bounds
original_all_landmarks_certification: inherited unverified; this is a display/body-span calibration, not original anatomy certification
